metadata.title: A Reproducible Methodological Framework for Prosecutorial Congestion Risk Prediction Using Explainable Machine Learning and Temporal Validation: code and Colab notebook
metadata.description:
Code and Colab notebook for the paper A Reproducible Methodological Framework for Prosecutorial Congestion Risk Prediction Using Explainable Machine Learning and Temporal Validation, submitted to Machine Learning with Applications (Elsevier).

The pipeline reads the open administrative records of the Public Prosecutor's Office of Peru (2019–2026), builds the leakage-controlled congestion target, selects features by the consensus of six methods, and trains and evaluates nine model configurations under year-block walk-forward validation, with a hold-out test on 2025 and a prospective evaluation on 2026. Every table and figure in the paper is written by the pipeline.

Run end to end with the included Colab notebook (notebooks/experiments.ipynb) or locally with python run_all.py; dependencies are listed in requirements.txt. Internal code: C15-2026.
